stages.name: install
stages.assertion: Isolated Homarr, ntfy and Jellyfin install and headless setup completed.

stages.name: administrator-board
stages.assertion: Administrator session read private Home, made and reverted a benign edit; anonymous private reads denied or excluded. Upstream private seeded board adopted with null creator.

stages.name: notification-roundtrip
stages.assertion: Authenticated ntfy publish/read matched exact ID and body; Homarr exposed that notification and current nonzero message statistics; anonymous topic access denied.

stages.name: synthetic-media-release
stages.assertion: Jellyfin scanned owned generated PCM audio and Homarr media releases matched its exact item and integration IDs.

stages.name: idempotency-restart
stages.assertion: Repeated setup and restart preserved dashboard resource identities without duplicates.

stages.name: url-reconciliation
stages.assertion: Drifted browser URL repaired; LAN_IP=127.0.0.2 metadata change preserved loopback-only binding and resource identities.

stages.name: credential-recovery
stages.assertion: Invalid owned ntfy token produced exit2 and targeted homarr/link-ntfy failure with retry hint. Restoring the original token and retrying preserved resources and recovered the real notification roundtrip.

stages.name: add-remove
stages.assertion: Transient Gatus tile add/remove reconciled; ntfy removal/reinstall reconciled tiles/integration/widgets/notebook while preserving Jellyfin resources and shared administrator credentials.

stages.name: browser-dashboard
stages.assertion: Real form administrator login, normal tour dismissal, live notification/media/notebook content and loaded App icons; root visually verified four readable native screenshots.

board_attribution: adopted private seeded board; creator not assigned by upstream
visual_review: Root viewed all four native PNGs: populated, unobstructed, readable, icons loaded; ntfy messages, synthetic Jellyfin release and secret-free notebook visible.
scope_limits: 127.0.0.2 is loopback configuration metadata, not proof of physical LAN reachability.
Selfhost E2E Tone is authorized generated 1-second mono16-bit PCM WAV audio; library and release visibility proved, playback or streaming not exercised.
App tiles, integration API data and visible widgets are separate observed claims.
Credential recovery restored the known valid owned token; the suggested ntfy repair command was not exercised in that negative-token stage.
Recorded image identities cover Homarr, ntfy and Jellyfin; transient Gatus was removed before final browser proof.

ci.head: 374bd1c813aa6f2d32580f1ae4fe2711a0ecb427
ci.scope: Green CI and final functional/browser/TUI proof use the same immutable head374bd1c813aa6f2d32580f1ae4fe2711a0ecb427.

actual_tui.review: Real native PTY session after all nine stages passed. Root viewed all three TUI PNGs; readable Dashboard, expanded Workflow and Install search. No logs/credentials UI/mutations.
actual_tui.chronology: All nine API/browser stages passed before capture pause. Actual native PTY Dashboard, Space-expanded Workflow and Install search were captured read-only; root reviewed all seven PNGs, then the fixture resumed and owned cleanup passed.
